    Extending a mesh weight from one periodic component (Proposition 7.5) #

    A mesh weight on a periodic component T of Q extends to a mesh weight on Q which agrees with it on the edges inside T and vanishes on the edges inside every other periodic component (exists_ext_wt). The values on the unmatched edges of the collapse of Lemma 4.2 are prescribed (the given weight inside T, zero elsewhere), and the matched edges are solved from their triangles (Morse.zval); the triangles which solve edges inside a periodic component lie in that component.

          Lemma 4.3 (lem:periodic-weight-extension): every closed edge weight, with values in an abelian group, on the union of the periodic subcomplexes extends to a closed edge weight on K. Closed means that the triangle relations hold; the extension solves the edges matched by the collapse of Lemma 4.2 from their triangles (Morse.zval), with the prescribed values on the unmatched periodic edges and zero on the other unmatched edges.
